name: Laborer
text:
Laborer: You may do the Build Supply Center
action with 1 fewer card if you spend 2 Supply cubes
from your Character card.

mechanics.trigger: When doing the Build Supply Center action
mechanics.effect: Spend 2 Supply cubes from your Character card to do Build Supply Center with 1 fewer card.
restrictions: Requires spending 2 Supply cubes from your Character card
